title: Sidecar check
author: Iced-Cream
description: A test for the core-ar2 0.11 calls the Sidecar mods use, checked in RAM. Part 1 (core 0.11): a SIDECAR CHECK page behind the LFO key and one behind the FX LFO key, with knob ids 560..563 whose p-locks the mod keeps itself (core_param_locks): per id, track and step, in RAM, with every call logged after the magic SCK1. The knobs show their labels (SCA..SCD) and names (SC KNOB A..D), with a trig held the value text shows the held step (core_held_step), and on each tick it notes track 1's trigs and lock trigs on steps 1..16. Part 2 (core 0.11): a step tag owner (core_step_owners) whose tags it sets, reads and walks on commands written into its record after the magic SCK2, logging every ev_steps event; and a measure of the heap's free space. Part 3 (core 0.11): the moments, after the magic SCK3: a SysEx handler that takes F0 7D messages and lets the rest through, USB MIDI bursts through core_midi_try_send from the UI task and from the audio interrupt, the current kit, track, pattern and project name each tick, the name at ev_project_save, two handle fields walked by core_handle_fields, and every ev_kit and ev_project_slot logged. Part 4 (core 0.11): the sequencer, after the magic SCK4: every ev_seq_step and ev_transport logged with the getters at that moment (the PLAY seed apart), per-track step and trig counts, ev_seq_tick's count and the getters' last values, and two more ev_seq_step subscribers that work only when a command asks, for the cost with 1 and 3. Part 6 (core 0.11): payloads, after the magic SCK6: a 1 MB payload of a known pattern, found through core_payload and read back whole at the first tick and on command. Part 7 (core 0.11): the interrupt send and the step getters, after the magic SCK7: on command a numbered SysEx of a set length from each ev_seq_step (or each of 96 ev_seq_ticks) through core_midi_try_send, core_track_length of every track each tick, and core_step_trig of the pattern playing. From 0.8, over USB MIDI for a unit run: F0 7D 53 43 SysEx commands that set any part's command word and send any part's record back. From 0.9 there is no part 5: remote fields left core 0.11.
